actions.action: Keep plant in bright shade or dappled/morning sun for 1–2 weeks
Gradually increase direct sun by 1–2 hours every 1–2 weeks, adding afternoon sun last
Settle plant in a spot with 4–6 hours of direct sun, with afternoon shade in hot climates
Watch for bleached, tan or brown patches and move back a step if seen
Check soil and water only when fully dry and leaves slightly less plump
Ensure good drainage and use gritty cactus mix in the hanging basket
Set fallen leaves on soil to propagate
Bring indoors or protect plant when temperatures near freezing
Post again if mushy, translucent, black or shriveled leaves appear
